subject: RE: DPA execution — signer eligibility and e-sign routing checklist
messages:
From: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@novapay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Davis <tim.davis@novapay.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaPay DPA - final redline and execution questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the DPA. Attached is our internal redline (NovaPay_DPA_Redline_v3.docx) — overall looks good but our legal team flagged two execution logistics items before we proceed to DocuSign: 

1) Signer authority: they need confirmation that Redwood countersignature will be done by someone listed on your corporate authority matrix (we typically need title + name on the envelope).
2) E-sign vendor: we prefer DocuSign but need to confirm envelope routing (who signs first, whether countersign is required, and whether witness/notification should be enabled).

Can you confirm who will be the Redwood signer, how you intend to route the envelope (order and recipients), and approximate timeline for completion? We want to avoid reissuing envelopes if legal swaps a signer.

Appreciate it — priya

--
Priya Mehta
Head of Legal Operations, NovaPay
priya.mehta@novapay.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@novapay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: NovaPay DPA - final redline and execution questions

Priya — thanks for the redline and the clear list. Quick answers below, and I copied Legal (Jordan/Laura) and Sales (Marcus) so we can follow through.

1) Signer authority: Redwood will countersign. Our authorized sig is Marcus Lin, VP, Revenue Operations. He is listed on our corporate signature matrix. If NovaPay requires a name/title string on the envelope, we will set the signatory as "Marcus Lin (VP, Revenue Operations)".
2) DocuSign routing: propose the following routing order to minimize envelope churn: 
   - Step 1 (In-person/remote): NovaPay primary signer (Tim Davis, CFO) signs first.
   - Step 2: NovaPay legal Ops (Priya) receives copy for internal acceptance (optional acknowledgement checkbox).
   - Step 3 (Final): Redwood countersigns (Marcus Lin).
   - Witness: not required by Redwood for this DPA.

We will not require a separate witness. If NovaPay needs witness or notarization, flag it now — that will change timeline.

Estimated timeline: once routing is confirmed and redline accepted, Marcus can countersign within 24 business hours.

I attached a short DocuSign_Envelope_Instructions.pdf with our preferred envelope settings (signature placement, routing order, and authentication: email + access code optional).

Next steps: please confirm the routing and whether you want the signer titles displayed on the envelope.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

From: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@novapay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Davis <tim.davis@novapay.com>, legal@novapay.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: NovaPay DPA - final redline and execution questions

Thanks Hannah — that routing looks fine. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

- We confirm Tim will sign first. He wants his title on the envelope (Tim Davis, CFO).
- Regarding authority: NovaPay requires counterparty signer's title + a secondary contact for audit. Can Redwood provide an email alias for an audit contact (e.g., contracts@redwood.com) to appear on the envelope metadata?
- DocuSign settings: we prefer signer authentication = email only; NovaPay legal wants a copy of the fully executed PDF routed back to legal@novapay.com and also uploaded to our DealSpace (HubSpot) via envelope hooks.

Assuming Redwood agrees, we'll accept the current redline and Tim will sign Monday morning. Please confirm Marcus will be available then.

Priya

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@novapay.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: NovaPay DPA - final redline and execution questions

Priya — legal here. Appreciate the quick coordination. Confirmations below: 

- Signature metadata: Redwood will populate signatory title and add contracts@redwood.com as the audit contact in the envelope metadata.
- Routing and webhooks: we will set the DocuSign envelope to: Signer 1 = Tim Davis (serial signer), Signer 2 = Marcus Lin (countersign). The envelope will have a post-execution webhook to push the signed PDF to your HubSpot deal and an email copy to legal@novapay.com.
- Authentication: email-only is acceptable for us. We will not require access codes.
- Countersign mechanics: Marcus will receive an inline countersign step (not a delegated signature). If Marcus is unavailable, we will add an alternate signer (Laura Bennett, GC in waiting) and notify you before sending.

Action items for Redwood (Laura/Jordan): finalize envelope, create draft in our DocuSign tenant, and share preview link with Priya for confirmation before sending.

Action for Sales (Ben/Marcus/Hannah): confirm business-level acceptance post-redline and confirm send window (Marcus availability).

Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@novapay.com>, Tim Davis <tim.davis@novapay.com>

Subject: RE: NovaPay DPA - final redline and execution questions

Hi Priya / Tim — Marcus here. Confirmed: I will countersign on Monday after Tim executes. I am available between 10:00–11:30 AM PT or 2:00–4:00 PM PT. If Tim signs in the morning, I will countersign by 11:30 AM; if he signs later, I will countersign in the afternoon.

We are good with contracts@redwood.com as the audit contact. Laura/Jordan: please ensure the envelope metadata includes that alias and the HubSpot webhook. Hannah/Ben: please confirm with Tim which of the two windows he plans to sign in so we can avoid reissuing.

Thanks — Marcus
